title: Brightstar Lottery Receives iCAP Ready Accreditation from National Council on Problem Gambling

body_markdown:
**Renewed accreditation recognizes Brightstar for upholding highest levels of responsible gaming standards in iLottery operations**


LONDON


, Nov. 4, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- Brightstar Lottery PLC (NYSE: BRSL) ("Brightstar" or "the Company") announced today that it has once again received the Internet Compliance Assessment Program ("iCAP") Ready accreditation for its iLottery operations from the National Council on Problem Gambling


("NCPG").


Based on the original iCAP designed for gaming operators, iCAP Ready is a U.S. accreditation program designed for gaming suppliers who are committed to upholding responsible gaming standards across their products and services. Supported by the NCPG, iCAP Ready utilizes best practices from the Internet Responsible Gambling


Standards to ensure suppliers implement and maintain responsible gambling


policies, provide effective staff training, and offer comprehensive player support tools.


*"We are proud to receive iCAP Ready accreditation again for our iLottery business, and it is especially meaningful to do so for the first time as a pure play lottery business* ," said **Wendy Montgomery, Brightstar Senior Vice President Branding, Communications and Sustainability.** *"This achievement is a testament to Brightstar's comprehensive responsible gaming processes and practices and our commitment to protecting our employees, customers and players across the globe."*


To achieve the accreditation, an overall compliance assessment was performed by a third party on behalf of NCPG to ensure Brightstar's responsible gaming framework met iCAP Ready's objective of protecting the consumer and ensuring safer gambling


practices for players, beginning with the supplier. The Company was the first gaming industry supplier to receive this accreditation in 2024.


For more information on Brightstar's global sustainability program, visit brightstarlottery.com or follow Brightstar on[LinkedIn](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4813635-1&h=3575985904&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Fcompany%2Fbrightstar-lottery%2F%3FviewAsMember%3Dtrue&a=LinkedIn) .


**About Brightstar Lottery PLC** Brightstar Lottery PLC (NYSE: BRSL) is a global leader in lottery focused on innovation and forward-thinking strategies, building on our renowned expertise in delivering secure technology and producing reliable, comprehensive solutions for our customers. As a premier pure play global lottery company, our best-in-class lottery operations, retail and digital solutions, and award-winning lottery games enable our customers to achieve their goals, entertain players and distribute meaningful benefits to communities. Brightstar has a well-established local presence and is a trusted partner to governments and regulators around the world, creating value by adhering to the highest standards of service, integrity, and responsibility. Brightstar serves nearly 90 lottery customers and their players on six continents. It is the primary technology provider to 26 of the 46 lottery jurisdictions in the U.S. and eight of the world's 10 largest lotteries with central systems. Brightstar has approximately 6,000 employees. For more information, please visit[www.brightstarlottery.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4813635-1&h=3879859549&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.brightstarlottery.com&a=www.brightstarlottery.com) or follow along on[LinkedIn](https://www.brightstarlottery.com/news-and-insights/news-releases/2026/linkedin.com/company/brightstar-lottery) .
